jobs.title: Director, APAC Sales, Optical Semiconductors & 3D Sensing
jobs.description:
Lumotive is pioneering the era of programmable optics—where light is controlled as intelligently and flexibly as software.

At the heart of this transformation is a once-in-a-generation innovation: a flat CMOS-based “general purpose optic.” Lumotive’s Light Control Metasurface (LCM™) beam forming chips can be programmed to function as a beam steering mirror, a lens, mirror, a beam splitter—or any optical function—replacing bulky and mechanical optical components with a fully digital, reconfigurable semiconductor . This breakthrough lays the foundation for a massive shift in multiple technologies—from 3D sensing and imaging to optical networking, free space optical communication, and beyond. Like the shift from analog to digital in electronics, programmable optics will reshape industries from robotics, self-driving cars, AI, defense, and healthcare.

Lumotive’s first commercial application is in LiDAR, where its software-defined beam steering chips are already enabling compact, high-performance, solid-state sensors. These sensors are being deployed today in smart infrastructure, robotics, and mobility systems through leading module makers and solution integrators.

With more than 200 patents and growing commercial traction, Lumotive is delivering the world’s first digital platform for light—and redefining what’s possible in the optical age.

### **Job Description:**

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Sales Director to lead and grow Lumotive’s business across APAC. Based in Taipei, you will own the regional revenue plan, build relationships with module makers, OEMs, ODMs, and system integrators, and convert design-in opportunities into high-volume production. As Lumotive’s first team member in the region, you will combine technical fluency, deep market knowledge, and commercial leadership, with the opportunity to shape Lumotive’s go-to-market presence in one of the world’s most important markets for 3D sensing, which includes Taiwan, China, Japan and Korea.

1.臨場企業服務。2.職災個案病房訪視衛教。3.行政相關作業。

資格條件：

1.國內外公私立大學護理學(科)或相關科系(含醫管、醫企)畢業，領有 護理師及職業衛生護理師證書。
  
2. 歇業 2 年（含）以上需重新申請執業登記者，應具有執業登記前一年內 已修滿 20 點積分之證明文件。
  
3.具中華民國國籍且無雙重國籍者，亦未具臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例 第21條第1項不得任用之情事。
  
4. 本院現職醫務契約同仁（含研究助理）報名甄試，需檢附服務單位報告書。
  
5. 具前述各項資格條件，如甄試總成績相當時，依下列次序優先錄用：
  
甲、職護工作經驗或護理臨床服務工作 1 年以上者。
  
乙、「依國軍退除役官兵輔導條例第六條規定，條件相等而為退除役官兵者，應予優先錄用」。

報名方式：

1.下載報名表：請至本院人事室網頁/下載專區/任免組/下載並填妥「職缺外補甄試報名表」。
  
2. 寄送報名表：報名表電子檔 E-MAIL 予承辦人：黃小姐(信箱： hyhsien @vghks.gov.tw)。

檢附資料：

1 護理師專門職業及技術人員高等考試及格或護理師檢覈考試及格證書影本。
  
2 學歷畢業證書影本。
  
3 護理師證書正、反面影本。
  
4 執業執照正、反面影本。
  
5 身分證正、反面影本。
  
6 職業衛生護理工作證明。
  
7 品德查詢同意書（凡參與甄選者，視為同意本院辦理刑案查詢作業，請至本院人事室網頁/下載專區/任免組/下載「品德查詢同意書」並請簽名及蓋章）。
  
8 如有歇業 2 年(含)以上報名者，必須檢附 1 年內 20 點繼續教育積分證明，併同審查。
  
9 以下證件無者免附：
  
a. 內或外科臨床護理工作證明。
  
b. 內或外科臨床護理工作證明。
  
c. 身心障礙證書影本。
  
d. 榮民或家長為榮民身份證明文件。
  
e. 本院現職醫務契約同仁（含研究助理）所屬服務單位報告書

甄選方式：

1.筆試：60%（專業知識）。

「應徵者所繳文件應保證真實無訛，如有虛偽不實、偽造或刻意隱瞞等情事，一經查證屬實，取消甄試資格，如經錄取，取消錄取資格，不得異議。凡涉及不法情事，應徵者應自負法律責任並依法究辦」。
